description: This file defines the KerberosSaslHelper class, providing static methods for creating and managing Kerberos-based SASL transports and processor factories within the Hive Thrift server authentication framework.

classes.name: KerberosSaslHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for Kerberos SASL transport and processor creation.

classes.name: CLIServiceProcessorFactory
classes.description: Inner class extending TProcessorFactory to produce processors that wrap the ThriftCLIService with SASL security.

methods.name: getKerberosProcessorFactory
methods.description: Returns a TProcessorFactory for the given SASL server and ThriftCLIService.

methods.name: getKerberosTransport
methods.description: Creates a Kerberos-authenticated TTransport for a given principal and host.

methods.name: createSubjectAssumedTransport
methods.description: Creates a TTransport assuming the subject for the given principal.

methods.name: getTokenTransport
methods.description: Creates a TTransport using a token string for authentication.
